description: Business days calculator with a caller-supplied calendar: add or subtract N working days from a date, or count the working days between two dates. The weekend is a weekday mask (Friday-Saturday and Sunday-only weeks work) and holidays are an explicit date list, so nothing depends on a stale holiday table. Returns the result date, the day count and the skipped dates with reasons. The skipped list is capped at 1,000 entries (skipped_truncated flags it); skipped_total is always exact. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

days.description: Business days to add, -3650 to 3650. Required when op=add. Accepted: integer between -3650 and 3650.

from.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Accepted: a calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

holidays.description: Comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD holiday dates. Accepted: comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD dates, at most 2048 characters.

inclusive.description: For op=count: start (default, half-open [from, to)), both or neither. Accepted: start, both, neither.

op.description: add (default) N business days to from, or count business days between from and to. Accepted: add, count.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, may precede from. Required when op=count. Accepted: a calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

weekend.description: Comma-separated weekday names or ISO numbers. Default sat,sun. Empty string = no weekend. Accepted: comma-separated weekday names (mon..sun) or ISO numbers 1-7.

name: business_days_calculate
title: Business days calculator: add or count working days with your weekend mask and holiday list
